_doc: Upstreams we take code from (D33). pin says how to find the version we use. policy: cherry-pick for code we changed, bump for code we use as is. tools/upstream_report.py reads this. OpenVT is not tracked: the app is a fork of it, not a downstream (user 2026-10-31).

upstreams.name: ayagami-gd
upstreams.note: Our fork (D25). Check every commit's source: nothing written from the Cubism SDK or Framework (D26).

upstreams.name: libfunnel
upstreams.note: PipeWire video out (D34). Maintained best-effort by its author, who asks to fork for new features: our copy is a fork, we fix what we need.

upstreams.name: ayagami
upstreams.note: Unmodified. cargo update -p ayagami in app/thirdparty/ayagami, rebuild, render regression.

upstreams.name: godot-rust (gdext)
upstreams.note: Released crate, bump with ayagami-gd when it needs a newer one.

godot.note: Patch releases of the same minor through AyagamiDev's build. A new minor is its own project. When the PR is merged, switch to official builds.
